steps.en: Serves the web UI backed by an embedded SQLite database — no external DB to provision to start
steps.zh: 以内嵌 SQLite 支撑起 Web UI——起步无需外接数据库

steps.en: Sign in (admin/admin at first boot) and register your existing backends as data sources
steps.zh: 登录（首启 admin/admin），把已跑的后端登记为数据源

steps.en: Forwards each panel's query to that backend in the backend's own language — PromQL, LogQL, SQL
steps.zh: 把面板查询按后端自己的语言转发——PromQL、LogQL、SQL

steps.en: Lay out dashboards mixing metric, log, and trace panels over one shared time range
steps.zh: 把指标、日志、trace 面板排进同一时间轴

steps.en: Evaluates your alert rules continuously and sends notifications to Slack, PagerDuty, or email
steps.zh: 持续评估告警规则，向 Slack、PagerDuty、邮件发通知

value.en: One pane of glass over all your telemetry — spike-to-log-to-trace correlation without moving data into Grafana
value.zh: 所有遥测一块统一面板——尖刺到日志到追踪的关联，而不必把数据搬进 Grafana

sources: grafana.com docs 'Run Grafana Docker image' (retrieved 2026-09-28): docker run -d -p 3000:3000 --name=grafana ...; editions 'grafana/grafana' (Open Source) and 'grafana/grafana-enterprise'; 'By default, Grafana uses an embedded SQLite version 3 database'
grafana.com docs 'Build your first dashboard' (retrieved 2026-09-28): 'go to http://localhost:3000/'; 'enter admin for both the username and password'
README.md main @ 2026-09-28: 'send notifications to systems like Slack, PagerDuty, VictorOps, OpsGenie'; 'You can specify a data source on a per-query basis'
